description:
The Upper Colo Reserve offers a wilderness camping experience with great access to the Colo River. NO caravans are permitted at the Reserve due to the very narrow and windy road to the Reserve.

Campsites are unmarked and suitable for tents and camper trailers. Camp fires are permitted in existing fire pits and there is a shelter area near the amenities block with a gas BBQ.

The Reserve is open for Spring, Summer and Autumn.
name: Upper Colo Reserve
